metaDescription: Every bank account you have linked to Horizon.
title: My banks
subtext: All your connected accounts with their latest balance, from the statements you uploaded.
emptyBody: Upload a bank statement to add your first account.
receivingCodeHint: Others use this code to send you money. Tap to copy it.
digitsHint: This statement did not show the account number. Add its last 4 digits, so later statements from this account land here.
renameInvalid: Give the account a name of 2 to 40 characters.
renameTaken: You already have an account with this name and these digits.
renameLinked: Only an account from a statement can be renamed.
digitsInvalid: Type the last 4 digits of the account number.
digitsAlreadySet: This account already has its number.
digitsTaken: Another account at this bank already ends with those digits.
coverageIntro: What your uploaded statements cover, and where entries may be missing. A hole is reported only where the saved entries show one: a statement that simply ends does not prove the weeks after it are missing.
coverageOk: No holes in the entries saved.
coverageHoleDates: Possibly missing: {from} to {to}, {days} days with no entries.
coverageHoleBalance: The balances do not join up between {from} and {to}: entries around those days may be missing.
coverageLatestOld: No entries since {date}, {days} days ago. If you have a newer statement, add it.
